items.title: David Torkanowsky interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, September 26, 2019
items.q: There’s a great drummer named John Vidacovich in New Orleans that I played with a long time ago in the Astral Project

ctx.x: Wow. Do you have goals? Musical goals?

There’s a great drummer named John Vidacovich in New Orleans that I played with a long time ago in the Astral Project, and we get to play together some, just a wonderful painter. And I heard him on the radio and the radio DJ said, “What’s your plans for the future?” And he goes, “Wow man, I hope to make my gig on time tonight.” So my goals are to — not be forgotten— record more. I just did, I told you I did this Newport record which I’ve been kind of editing on and working on. I’ll tell you a cool story. I…
It’s not a bad school to be.
